PriorValue.description: Optional prior value of the field, used for change detection and logging.  Use DBNULL for null values.

UpdateReadOnly.description: When TRUE target field can be read only and will be updated in memory

ProjectPrograms.description: Describes the link between a project and a program (xsfProgramProjectMap via Project Abstract)

Created.description: When this project was added to this program

Active.description: When True, this program is active

ProjectLink.description: Attributes describing a Link to a parent or child  project

DocMasterKey.description: Key for document that owns the link

IsChild.description: When True, this is a child project

ProjectWBS.description: Describes an WB Code that is part of a Project WBS

WBCode.description: Work Breakdown code, often a combination of a CSI and phase

Description.description: Free form explaination or generic description (!!!)

ContractType.description: FP/TM etc as site defined in xsfDocTypeSubcodes

UOM.description: Code for Unit of Measure (from Code List, set UOM)

SOVLine.description: Links WBS item to a SOV item

SOVRootDMK.description: DMK of SOV that adds this line

example.At: Campus Plains, Campus County Airport, NY

ZipCode.description: Zip Code for which this reading was obtained

Location.description: Description of Location (JFK Airport, New York, NY)

ProjectTranDetail.description: Read only description of an cost transaction posted to a project

RowKey.description: Key for this transaction (does not persist)

crtd_prog.description: Id of Source logic that recorded this transaction

crtd_user.description: User ID under which this transaction was recorded

lupd_datetime.description: Last Update of this transaction (typically matches CRTD_)

lupd_prog.description: Source logic of this transaction (typically matches CRTD_)

lupd_user.description: Source user generating this transaction (typically matches CRTD_)

project.description: ID of Project (suitable for use as a key)

emp_name.description: Employee Name (blank if user lacks permission)

ProjectCommitmentDetail.description: Read only description of an open committed cost posted to a project

crtd_prog.description: Id of Source logic that recorded this transaction

crtd_user.description: User ID under which this transaction was recorded

lupd_datetime.description: Last Update of this transaction (typically matches CRTD_)

lupd_prog.description: Source logic of this transaction (typically matches CRTD_)

lupd_user.description: Source user generating this transaction (typically matches CRTD_)

emp_name.description: Employee Name (blank if user lacks permission)

EmployeeId.description: Employee Name (blank if user lacks permission)

Action.description: Set if value has a click action

ArrOpenResult.description: Everything the Webix arr view needs to render, plus the (optional) ARR session token.

RouteeUserName.description: Display name of the routee (the "For" person).

RouteeEmail.description: Routee email (used for the confirmation checkbox; also a phase-2 verification target).

FromUserName.description: Display name of the person the route replies to.

ContentAsOf.description: Timestamp the routed content was set/resolved.

HasContent.description: True when there is routed content available to download.

FirstViewed.description: When the routee first viewed this route, if ever.

Responded.description: When the routee last responded to this route, if ever.

IsConfidential.description: True when the document is confidential.

RequiresVerification.description: Phase 1: when true, no AccessToken is issued and the view shows a "verification coming soon" state.

ShowRouteResponseArea.description: Whether the free-form response area should be shown.

ShowRouteResponseCode.description: Whether the response-code dropdown should be shown.

CanEditRouteResponse.description: Whether the response text may still be edited.

CanEditRouteResponseCode.description: Whether the response code may still be changed.

AllowSendBack.description: Whether the routee is permitted to send the document back.

AllowRestart.description: Whether the routee is permitted to restart the route.

ResponseCodeChoices.description: Available response-code choices (Key = code, Value = description).

AccessToken.description: 59-minute MachineKey-protected token; sent back as the X-SF-ARR header on subsequent ARR calls.

ArrOpenRequest.description:
Route Response Wizard (ARR / case 36631) data-transfer objects, shared between the sfPMS web app
(ARRController) and the OpenAPI/Swagger client. Moved here from ARRController.vb so they live with the
rest of the DataSupportModels.

RecaptchaToken.description: reCAPTCHA Enterprise token from the client, assessed before the route is resolved.

Saved.description: True when the response was saved.

RouteID.description: Route being acted on (must match the ARR token's route).

ResponseHtml.description: Response HTML produced by the editor.

SendConfirmation.description: When true, email a confirmation to the routee.

DocType.description: Default Process (Doc Type) Name (You probably want SiteName)

MobileDashboard.description: When True, shown on Mobile dashboards

ProjectDashboard.description: When True, shown on project dashboards

CloudSync.description: When True, can be sync'd to cloud storage (other rules apply)

CreateFromParent.description: When True, is created from a parent document

CrossProjectNumbering.description:
When True, Document Numbers are sequenced across projects (PO,Work Posted, etc)
When False, numbers start over on every project (See DocNumbering | StartDocNumber)

NewFromDashboard.description: When True, can create from project dashboard

ProjectIsOptional.description: When True, Project is an optional field (Rare)

UseItemRegister.description: When True, uses an item register

ParentTypeKey.description: Key for optional parent Process Type (commitment and cco)

Custom.description: When true, this is a locally defined Process Type (specific to this site)

SeatType.description: Seat category consumed by this session (Web or Mobile Field)

Concurrent-seat category. Web (named/concurrent browser + REST) seats and Spitfire Mobile Field
seats are tracked as fully separate pools.

SupportRequest.description: Forwards the request to the SWS endpoint

Topic.description: Freeform topic of the support request, e.g. "Error when trying to save a project"

SupportAttachment.description: Information about something to attach to the support request, e.g. a log file.

AttachmentName.description: Typically sflink.log or something.  Include the extension!
